# Victoria and Albert Museum (V&A)

> > World's leading museum of art, design and performance with major collections spanning decorative arts, fashion, textiles, metalwork, and cultural heritage from South Asia, India, and beyond.

The V&A operates multiple locations including V&A South Kensington in London, V&A Dundee in Scotland, and Young V&A (formerly Museum of Childhood) in Bethnal Green. The museum houses over 2.3 million objects with significant collections of South Asian textiles, Mughal art, metalwork, and contemporary design, while hosting exhibitions on fashion, photography, videogames, and theatre performance.

## Museum Collections

- [South Asia – Explore the Collections](http://www.vam.ac.uk/content/articles/c/collecting-south-asian-textiles): South Asian collection overview: 60,000 objects from India & Himalayas
- [Metalwork – Explore the Collections](http://www.vam.ac.uk/page/m/metalwork/index.html): Metalwork collection: 45,000 objects from Bronze Age to present
- [Young V&A](https://www.vam.ac.uk/moc/collections/scalextric): Young V&A children's museum in Bethnal Green, Art Fund winner 2024

## Major Exhibitions and Displays

- [Inside the Tim Walker: Wonderful Things exhibition](https://www.vam.ac.uk/articles/inside-the-tim-walker-wonderful-things-exhibition): Tim Walker photography exhibition inspired by V&A collection objects
- [Videogames exhibition opens at V&A Dundee](https://www.vam.ac.uk/dundee/info/videogames-exhibition-opens-at-va-dundee): V&A Dundee videogames exhibition opening announcement
- [Fashion in Motion: Gareth Pugh](https://www.vam.ac.uk/articles/fashion-in-motion-gareth-pugh): Gareth Pugh 2007 catwalk show at V&A Fashion in Motion series

## Conservation and Behind the Scenes

- [Advanced Works Project: Auditing the Theatre and Performance's Costume Collection](https://www.vam.ac.uk/blog/caring-for-our-collections/advanced-works-auditing-the-theatre-and-performances-costume-collections): Theatre costume collection audit at Blythe House with BFI archive
- [Nature in Focus](https://www.vam.ac.uk/blog/projects/nature-in-focus): Behind-the-scenes photography techniques for Fashioned from Nature
- [Languages, Sprachen, Yaziki and more in Design Archives](https://www.vam.ac.uk/blog/news/languages-sprachen-yaziki-and-more-in-design-archives): Multilingual design archives featuring Jewish emigré designers

## Museum News and Digital

- [UK Museums on the Web Conference 2012](https://www.vam.ac.uk/blog/digital/uk-museums-on-the-web-conference-2012): Museums conference recap: digital strategy & agile methodology
- [Sounds of Christmas!](https://www.vam.ac.uk/blog/museum-of-childhood/sounds-of-christmas): Christmas audio trail featuring musical toys at Museum of Childhood
